heading: **19 January 2026**
body:
*1.55X SELEX buffer*

*1.55x Promega Buffer, 155μM EGTA, 1.55mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

250 mL

| Promega Buffer 1.55 (10X) | 38.75 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 77.5 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 387.5 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 7.5 uL |

Make up the volume to 250 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.  
Aliquot 8.5 uL per well of a 384-well plate.

*ELF lig2 & lig3 preparation*

ELF\_sm\_EcoRV \= ELF lig3

ELFlig\_noEcoRV \= ELF lig2

5X PCR for each ligand:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ELFlig2/3 \- 10 ng/uL** | **10 uL** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **62.5 uL** |
| **ELF\_FWD 10 uM** | **6.25 uL** |
| **ELF\_REV2/REV3 10 uM** | **6.25 uL** |
| **Water** | **40 uL** |
| **Total** | **125 uL** |

ELF lig3

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 59°C | 15 s       **35X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 10 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

ELF lig2

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 56°C | 15 s       **35X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 10 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

*Preparation of lig70N & lig200 plates*

lig200 PCR1 \= 23.2 ng/uL  
lig70N PCR1 round 2 \= 9.5 ng/uL

2X100

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 PCR1** | **500** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1500**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

Split mix into 25 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **3X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

The lig200 band was also very clean and the concentration of this product is fairly good.

Set up 2X plates of lig200 PCR1:

Take 4.5 uL of lig200 ssDNA and make up volume to 900 uL.

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Final diluted DNA** | **400** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1600** |
| **Total** | **5000** |

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Measure the concentration of this PCR product and run on an agarose gel.

*Hia5 test repeat*

Dilute 1 uL enzyme into 10 uL (dHia5).

| TF Dilution Buffer | 1.55X SELEX Buffer | DNA (30 ng) | SAM | dHia5 | Hia5 Buffer |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 1.5 | \- |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 1 | 0.5 |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 0.75 | 0.75 |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 0.5 | 1 |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 0.4 | 1.1 |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 0.3 | 1.2 |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 0.25 | 1.25 |
| 4.5 | 8.5 | 5 | 0.5 | 0.2 | 1.3 |

Incubate 1.5 hours for Hia5 treatment.

Add DpnI and rCutsmart buffer post treatment and then run on a gel to check for efficiency.
title: 1.55X SELEX buffer
